description: Dependencies the house stack has already answered. A bare name matches that package exactly — which is what keeps `jest` from taking `jest-expo` with it — and a `^`-prefixed entry is a regular expression over the package name. `adr` names a glob: where a deviation is legitimate, the entry unlocks once that file exists, so the exception is written down rather than argued in a review.

entries.reason: Drizzle over Bun.sql is the data layer
Bun's native Redis client; BullMQ brings its own driver internally, so no repo declares one
Eden Treaty types the client off the server's own type — there is no schema to generate from
Effect Schema on the server, zod at the edges
Base UI is the headless primitive set
TanStack Form is the form library
server state is TanStack Query and client state is React's own built-ins
Temporal on the server, @date-fns/tz in the client
charts are hand-rolled per the dataviz skill until TanStack Charts ships
Better Auth is the auth layer
Resend sends mail, Bun's S3 client holds objects, PostHog holds product analytics
Effect Schedule for in-process cadence, BullMQ for durable jobs
bun test is the runner, MSW fakes the network, Playwright drives the browser
React Native styles with StyleSheet over shared tokens
expo-secure-store holds secrets and MMKV holds everything else
